feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 July 2026 4:24pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 17 July 2026 at 4:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds developing in places late in the night and tomorrow morning.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the south of Iceland, with a ridge to the Norwegian Sea.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less in places at first, otherwise mainly North or Northeast 2 to 4 occasionally 5, backing mainly North to Northwest 3 to 5 this evening, then increasing 5 occasionally 6 through the North Channel and in the west of the area later in the night & tomorrow morning. Becoming North or Northwest 3 to 5 in all waters tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate in the North Channel this evening, then in the west overnight. Becoming slight occasionally moderate in all waters tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 3 to 5, veering North or Northeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
